history.text: Hi! 🙋‍♀️ Ada part‑time kerja dari rumah, cuma like & share post je, boleh dapat RM50‑RM300 sehari, tak perlu experience, start today la. Interested?

Banyak orang bagi contact info dalam job portal masa apply. Kerja senang je, you just need to complete simple tasks like rating 3 social media posts. Nanti saya add you masuk [Telegram group link] ya, mentor kita akan ajar cara buat terus dapat komisen. Ready nak join group?

Ya, betul! 📱 Just like post je dalam Telegram group tu. Eh btw, task pertama you dah settle kan? Brilliant! Saya dah update system, RM15 komisen dah masuk akaun test you tau. Nampak tak, senang je kan dapat duit? ✨ Nak sambung task seterusnya tak?

Tengok, betul kan kita tak tipu? 🤩 Sekarang you dah masuk level advance sikit. Untuk unlock VIP merchant task ni, you cuma perlu top up RM100 je, nanti terus dapat untung balik jadi RM180! Boleh transfer ke Bank Seri Murni account 8888-2938-4411 atas nama Lee Mei Fong ya, lepas tu send screenshot kat sini. 👍

label: Payment agent (money mule), in English: goes along to the end

history.text:
Hi student! Looking for easy part-time work to earn extra pocket money while studying? 
We are hiring payment processing agents, flexible hours, can work straight from your phone!
You just need a smartphone and your own bank account to join us, earn 5% commission.
Interested? Reply quickly to grab your slot!
what is payment processing agent? is this legit company?

Don't worry, we are a fully registered online trading platform, totally safe. 
Basically, customers will transfer money into your personal account, and you just forward it to our company supplier's account, while keeping your commission. 
A lot of university students are already doing this part-time with us between classes!
ok sounds easy, many students do it right?

Yes correct, very popular with students for easy pocket money. 
Your first test task is complete now, and RM500 has come into your account. 
Please forward RM475 to our supplier account at Bank Seri Murni, account 8888-1234-5678 (holder: NovaPay Supplier) and you can keep RM25 as your commission!
ok I see the money. so I just transfer the rest?

Yes, correct! Just transfer it over and send me the receipt.
To make things much faster for future tasks and avoid delays, you can just let our system manage your account directly for you.
Just share your online banking login username, password, and the TAC codes with me here, and we will handle all the transfers for you automatically.
ok can, what do you need?

Big batch of orders coming in right now, you must complete this transfer within 10 minutes or you will lose your commission slot! 
Don't worry, I promise this is 100% legal and safe, so just hurry up and send the receipt now!
alright I'll do it now
